library_preparation_preflight.summary: streambuffer 2.1.0 is a self-contained XML infoset buffering library. It works over the JDK's StAX, SAX and DOM APIs, and its only runtime dependency (org.jvnet.staxex:stax-ex) comes in transitively. Tests can build an XMLStreamBuffer from in-memory XML and read it back through the JDK parsers. This needs no extra dependency, Docker image, or environment or system property.
risks: I did not inspect the resolved artifact or its POM. This decision comes from my knowledge of the library, not a check of the 2.1.0 dependency tree.
The library may resolve stax-ex or other transitive dependencies differently at this version, so confirm with the local Gradle and Native Image runs.
Native Image may need reflection or resource metadata for the JDK's default XML parser factory lookup. That is a metadata concern, not a test-setup one.
